accounting_model.machine: 256-bit word RAM with a flat 2^256-word address space and abstract contiguous-array allocation. One word occupies 32 bytes.
accounting_model.primitive_operations: Load/store one word, move, bitwise Boolean operation, shift/rotate by 0..255, comparison, branch, and add/subtract/multiply/divide/remainder modulo 2^256 each cost one time unit. Division by zero is invalid. Explicit narrower arithmetic masks and control flow also cost operations.
accounting_model.hash_charge: One selected-target compression of one already materialized 64-byte block and incoming chaining state costs one time unit. Padding, message construction, input/output copies, and all other operations are charged separately. A whole variable-length hash is not a one-unit operation.
accounting_model.random_bits: One fresh independent uniform 256-bit word costs one time unit and one live word until consumed. No preallocated random tape or uncharged PRNG is implied. These coins define the algorithm's probability space, not a model of the target.
accounting_model.memory_charge: Peak simultaneously live bytes include every message, digest, array, metadata, random word, stack/state, code/constants, and advice. Arrays may be packed but shifts, masks and accesses are charged. Allocation costs one operation and one 256-bit descriptor; zero-initialization and writes are not free.

requirements: Prove success at least 0.39 for the concrete selected target; all repetitions and failure cases are counted.

time_log2 bounds total work including preprocessing, construction, search, filtering, verification and retries. preprocessing_log2 separately discloses the preprocessing portion; it is not subtracted from total time.
Report data and nonuniform advice separately, including provenance. Their generation must be counted where needed; embedding a known collision is not a free attack.
At least one time unit and one byte are represented by exponent zero; explain truly zero data/preprocessing/advice explicitly in prose.
Comparisons are scalar within the identical track/model/policy only. No cross-track ranking or Pareto requirement.
Nominal reference values are display/experiment starting targets, not admissible assumptions, established attack costs, or security bounds.
